sentences.text: Michael McCullers -LRB- born 1971 -RRB- is an American comedy film screenwriter .	American	United States	comedy	comedy	film	film	screenwriter	screenwriter

A native of Indian Springs Village , Alabama , McCullers attended Indian Springs School , a private high school just south of Birmingham , Alabama .	Indian Springs Village	Birmingham, Alabama	Alabama	Alabama	Indian Springs School	Indian Springs School

McCullers is a former writer on Saturday Night Live and is best known for co-writing the script for two Austin Powers movies , Austin Powers : The Spy Who Shagged Me and Austin Powers in Goldmember with Mike Myers .
